pairs.evidence: lib/script/trailer/rules/spine.ts:1 These rules are pure checkers that return findings: they hold no pending state, decision surface or continuation, and they say they are not gates (spine.ts:1, promises.ts 'report the rows and let a human read them'). A case-insensitive search of lib/script/trailer/rules found 0 hits for consent, hitl, awaiting, approve and grant; 'gate', 'human' and 'pending' appear only in comments and finding text.

pairs.subject: hitl-approval
pairs.evidence: app/(studio)/board/_port/real.ts:205 The Board's queue is built only by state (open, unopened, decided). The packet machine allows only open -> committed|returned, so an open packet never expires, has no reaper and has no 'expired unanswered' outcome, and the rail is not sorted by expiry or consequence. That breaks review-queues' hygiene rules: a pending item names its reaper, and the queue is triage, not an archive.

techniques.evidence: app/(studio)/board/_port/real.ts:205 The completeness half holds: kernel packets and v1 Weir piles are merged into one rail, and a rail read failure is shown rather than read as 'weir clear' (load.ts:46). The hygiene half fails: no expiry or reaper (packet.machine.ts: open -> committed|returned only), and the order is state plus opened_at, not expiring-soonest or highest-consequence first.
app/(studio)/board/_port/real.ts:217 The executor checks the recorded kernel head state before it acts, and every write is one kernel transaction.

app/(studio)/board/_port/real.ts:245 The commit records who decided (author: by, surface, who) and binds to what was shown: the preview token plus a fresh v1 digest. The kernel refuses with stale-preview when either has moved.

app/(studio)/board/_board/commitFlow.tsx:77 On a stale-preview refusal the flow previews again and shows the fresh consequence before another confirm. After commit, a durable apply outbox is kicked (real.ts:249), and a stuck apply has a redrive (actions.ts:72).

app/(studio)/board/_port/actions.ts:6 The decider is resolved from the session before any write. The MCP agent door only calls listPackets/loadPacket on the board (app/_server/mcp/tools/read.ts:100,115), so a machine token cannot post a verdict.
